description: This file defines the TicketDAO interface, which declares methods for CRUD operations and retrieval of Ticket entities in the application.

classes.name: TicketDAO
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Ticket entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Ticket object to the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Ticket objects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Ticket identified by its id.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket by its id.

methods.name: getTicketByTicketid
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket by its ticketId.

methods.name: getListBasedOnUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Tickets associated with a specific userId.
